mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalWarnings, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as highRiskWarnings, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mediumRiskWarnings, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lowRiskWarnings, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingWarnings, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processingWarnings, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'handled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as handledWarnings, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ignored' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ignoredWarnings FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_WARNING WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT WARNING_TYPE as warningType, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_WARNING WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'), 2) as percentage FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_WARNING WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY WARNING_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRIGGER_TIME, 'YYYY-MM') as month, COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as highCount, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mediumCount, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lowCount FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_WARNING WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND TRIGGER_TIME >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '#{months}' MONTH GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRIGGER_TIME, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month
